name: Bitunix
tagline: Top pick — high-leverage futures with low fees
min_deposit_note: No fixed account minimum; futures can be traded from about $10 in USDT.
max_leverage: Up to 200x on perpetual futures (varies by pair)
features: Spot, USDT-M perpetual futures, copy trading, Earn, TradingView charts
regulation: MSB registrations in the US (FinCEN) and Canada (FINTRAC), AUSTRAC registration (Australia), El Salvador Bitcoin Service Provider licence. Not MiCA-authorised in the EU.
kyc: You can sign up and deposit without KYC; ID verification (KYC Level 1) is required to withdraw.
best_for: Crypto futures traders, copy trading, low fees
pros: Up to 200x leverage on perpetual futures
Low futures fees (0.02% / 0.06%)
Copy trading and TradingView charting built in
Fast sign-up — deposit before full KYC
cons: No tier-1 trading licence (registrations are AML-focused)
Not available in the US, Canada, France, UAE, Singapore and about 20 other places
Very high leverage can wipe out an account quickly
summary: Bitunix is a fast-growing derivatives exchange launched in 2021. It focuses on USDT-margined perpetual futures with up to 200x leverage, low trading fees, copy trading and professional TradingView charts. It is our top pick for crypto futures traders in supported countries.

name: Binance
min_deposit_note: Deposit any amount of supported crypto; P2P and card purchases have their own small minimums.
max_leverage: Up to 125x on futures (lower limits for new users and some regions)
fees: Spot 0.10% / 0.10% (25% off with BNB) · Futures 0.02% maker / 0.05% taker
features: Spot, futures, options, P2P, Earn, copy trading, Binance Pay, Web3 wallet
regulation: Licensed or registered in many markets, including Dubai (VARA), Abu Dhabi (FSRA), France (AMF), Italy, Spain, Poland, Sweden, Bahrain (CBB), Kazakhstan (AFSA) and India (FIU-IND).

licences.entity: Nest Exchange / Nest Clearing & Custody / Nest Trading Ltd

licences.regulator: Autorité des marchés financiers (AMF) – DASP registration

kyc: Full KYC (ID + selfie) is required before you can deposit or trade.
best_for: Beginners and all-round traders who want maximum liquidity
pros: Deepest liquidity and largest trading volume
Huge product range: spot, futures, options, Earn, P2P
Licences in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Bahrain, Kazakhstan and several EU states
Low fees with BNB discount
cons: Futures restricted for retail users in some countries (e.g. UK, parts of the EU)
Not available in the US (separate Binance.US), Canada, Netherlands or Singapore
summary: Binance is the world's largest crypto exchange by trading volume, offering spot, futures, options, P2P trading and savings products. It holds licences and registrations in more jurisdictions than most rivals, but requires full KYC and limits some products (especially futures) by country.

name: BingX
min_deposit_note: Deposit any supported crypto, or buy through P2P / card partners.
copy_trading: Yes – one of the largest copy-trading platforms
features: Spot, perpetual futures, copy trading, grid bots, forex & stock perpetuals
regulation: MiCA authorisation in Austria (FMA, Oct 2026 – spot/custody, not derivatives), AUSTRAC registration (Australia), Lithuania FCIS registration.

licences.regulator: Austrian FMA – MiCA CASP authorisation (no derivatives)

kyc: Basic trading possible with limits; KYC unlocks higher withdrawal limits and fiat services.
best_for: Copy traders and beginners who want to follow experienced traders
pros: Market-leading copy trading
Competitive 0.02% / 0.05% futures fees
MiCA authorisation for its EU entity
Grid bots and forex/stock perpetuals
cons: EU MiCA licence does not cover derivatives
Copy traders pay profit share to leaders
Not available in the US, UK, Canada, Netherlands, Singapore, Hong Kong and others
summary: BingX is a global exchange founded in 2018 and best known for copy trading — millions of users follow professional traders automatically. It offers spot, perpetual futures up to 125x and grid bots, and its EU entity has a MiCA authorisation in Austria.

name: MEXC
min_deposit_note: Deposit any amount of supported crypto; card purchases have their own minimums.
max_leverage: Up to 200x on futures (varies by pair)
fees: Spot 0% maker / 0.05% taker · Futures 0% maker / 0.01–0.02% taker
features: Spot, futures, copy trading, launchpad, DEX+
regulation: Registered in Seychelles. No tier-1 licence (no SEC, FCA or MiCA authorisation).
kyc: Basic trading possible without KYC, but unverified withdrawals are capped (around 1,000 USDT per 24h in most regions).
best_for: Altcoin hunters, low-fee spot and futures trading
pros: Thousands of coins — new tokens list early
0% maker fees on spot and futures
Very low futures taker fees
Deep futures market with copy trading
cons: Not available in the US, Canada, UK, China, Hong Kong or Singapore
summary: MEXC is a Seychelles-registered exchange famous for listing new altcoins early and for some of the lowest trading fees in the industry. It is a strong second account for altcoin and futures traders, but it carries offshore-exchange risk.

name: KuCoin
min_deposit_note: No initial deposit required; crypto deposits are free.
features: Spot, margin, futures, trading bots, copy trading, Earn
regulation: MiCA authorisation in Austria (FMA, Nov 2025; EU operations pending), FIU-IND registration (India), AUSTRAC registration (Australia). Barred from serving US users under a CFTC order.

licences.regulator: Austrian FMA – MiCA CASP authorisation (operations pending)

kyc: KYC is required to trade and withdraw.
best_for: Altcoin traders and users of automated trading bots
pros: 1,000+ coins including many small caps
Built-in trading bots (grid, DCA)
SOC 2 Type II & ISO 27001 security certifications
Proof of reserves audited by Hacken
cons: Past regulatory settlement in the US
Not available in the US, China, Hong Kong, Singapore, Malaysia, France or Netherlands
Canadian provinces Ontario and BC are blocked
summary: KuCoin is a large global exchange launched in 2017 with more than 1,000 coins, built-in trading bots and copy trading. Its EU entity received MiCA authorisation in Austria, and it is registered in India and Australia, but it no longer serves US users.

name: BitBase
min_deposit_note: Deposit supported crypto by address/QR code or buy USDT/BTC through third-party payment partners.
features: Spot, USDT/USDC-margined perpetual futures, protection fund
regulation: Headquartered in Panama. No tier-1 licence.
kyc: Check BitBase's current verification tiers at sign-up.
best_for: Traders wanting a new futures venue alongside a main exchange
pros: USDT and USDC-margined perpetual futures up to 150x
Competitive futures fees
Advanced order types (Post-Only, Trigger)
iOS app available
cons: Very new — opened to the public in April 2026
Volume not yet tracked by CoinMarketCap
Smaller coin selection than larger exchanges
summary: BitBase is a new Panama-based exchange that opened to the public in April 2026, offering spot trading and USDT/USDC perpetual futures with up to 150x leverage. Because its track record is short, we suggest keeping only trading capital on it.
